root: ^You found that, huh? He leans against the anvil, rubbing his face as if exhausted.

^Fine. We used to be together… a long time ago. It ended, that’s all. But if you’re asking if I killed her— He glares at you, voice sharp like a blade. —then you don’t know a damn thing. Even if I hated her, I’d never do that to her. And I am sure as hell I didn’t hate her. He turns back to his work, effectively ending the conversation.
